{{Quote|Son, get the blaster rifles. Looks like we've got first contact with the locals.|Tallov Kersk, meeting the Muza for the first time|<ref name="RKD" />}}
'''Tallov Kersk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] settler and [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]]. He came to the planet with his family&mdash;his [[Tallov Kersk's wife|wife]], his brother-in-law [[Karn (settler)|Karn]], his [[Karn's wife|sister]], his son [[Vettle]], and his niece [[Cavvie]]<ref name="RKD" />&mdash;in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> Tallov Kersk and his family became the first settlers from the [[Brentaal League]] to encounter the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Muza]]. Kersk ordered his son to retrieve the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] for their encounter.<ref name="RKD" />
